finite-convex-projection.title: Nicholas Hu, Projections and least squares problems
finite-convex-projection.scope: Hilbert projection existence, variational characterization and firm nonexpansiveness. The arbitrary finite-constraint-net theorem and its proof are independently assembled.
support_locations: Firm nonexpansiveness of the projection operator
finite-convex-projection.reuse: Public concepts and facts; no copied exercise or prose. No unpublished OET material.

rockafellar-cyclic.title: R. T. Rockafellar, Characterization of the subdifferentials of convex functions, Pacific Journal of Mathematics 17(3), 497-510 (1966)
rockafellar-cyclic.scope: Section 2, Theorem 1 and its finite-path construction: a cyclically monotone relation on a real topological vector space embeds into a convex subdifferential. The normalized pointwise least-property proof is supplied explicitly.
support_locations: Printed pages 499-501, Section 2, Theorem 1 and proof
rockafellar-cyclic.reuse: Public theorem and construction, independently written proof and new task specification; no copied exercise or prose. No unpublished OET material.

spectral-finite-sections.title: A. C. Hansen, On the approximation of spectra of linear Hilbert space operators, PhD thesis
spectral-finite-sections.scope: Classical finite-section shift example shows that finite model spectra can fail to recover the limit spectrum. The c0 model with eventual exact norms of every polynomial and all proofs here are independently constructed.
support_locations: Official preprint Infinite Dimensional Numerical Linear Algebra: Theory and Applications, page 3
spectral-finite-sections.retrieval_note: Primary-source search extracts expose the cited finite-section passage; direct PDF fetch of thesis exceeded browser size limit. Author and thesis title verified on https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/research/afha/anders/.
spectral-finite-sections.reuse: Public background only; no copied exercise or source proof text. No unpublished OET material.
